title: Support Levels To Set Alerts On This Week
speaker: Drew Dosek

calls.condition: Expects a slight pierce to ~13.51 at the bottom of a 2-year channel, then a bounce (possibly on Oct 29 earnings) to 15.53-15.75
calls.reason: Sixth test of the bottom of a parallel channel since April 2024; daily RSI ~31.85, nearly oversold; selling steep into earnings.
calls.quote: I'm anticipating a slight pierce with price potentially coming down and touching this $13.51 marker.

calls.condition: If it pierces the all-time high, expect resistance at ~$200 and a pullback to 184-185
calls.reason: Double top at all-time high ~194 with bearish RSI divergence; top of rising channel 199.55 and round-number $200 should bring profit taking.
calls.quote: push price back down here into the 184 185 range on the chart of Shark Ninja.

calls.condition: If the rising trendline support gives way, buy zone ~247-256 offers a high-probability bounce
calls.reason: Bouncing off rising trendline from July 29/Sep 3 lows; capped by declining trendline from June weekly topping tail; $1.1B backlog.
calls.quote: If price gets down there, that should be a high probability chance of a bounce.

calls.condition: A second close below the broken uptrend line confirms more downside toward the 36.85 gap fill, then a bounce to retest the trendline
calls.reason: Uptrend from the June/July low violated over the last four sessions; gap fill at 36.85 just under the 38.2% Fib.
calls.quote: A second day pushing down lower would confirm that SMCI's near-term trend has broken and the likelihood for more downside would come.
